name: nested_rule
rule:
  variables:
  - name: "permitted_regions"
    expression: "['us', 'uk', 'es']"
  match:
  - rule:
      id: "banned regions"
      description: >
        determine whether the resource origin is in the banned
        list. If the region is also in the permitted list, the
        ban has no effect.
      variables:
      - name: "banned_regions"
        expression: "{'us': false, 'ru': false, 'ir': false}"
      match:
      - condition: |
          resource.origin in variables.banned_regions &&
          !(resource.origin in variables.permitted_regions)
        output: "true"
  - condition: resource.origin in variables.permitted_regions
    output: "{'banned': false}"
  - output: "{'banned': true}"

rule.description: determine whether the resource origin is in the banned list. If the region is also in the permitted list, the ban has no effect.

name: "errors_compose_conflicting_subrule"
description: "Tests for conflicting subrules in policy compilation"
sections:
- name: "compile"
  tests:
  - name: "incompatible_output_types"
    output:
      error_set:
      # Java: failed composing the subrule 'banned regions' due to incompatible output types.
      # Go: incompatible output types: block has output type map(string, bool), but previous outputs have type bool
      - "incompatible output types"

value.description: Tests for conflicting subrules in policy compilation
value.name: errors_compose_conflicting_subrule
